title: Enterprise Ask Triage Matrix & Scope Pulse
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and CS deliver a high volume of enterprise feature asks that vary widely in detail, priority signals, and technical feasibility. Current ad-hoc intake makes it slow for PM to prioritize and for Eng to estimate, which increases time-to-response and risks mis-scoping high-value work.

Goal: Build a lightweight, repeatable triage process and matrix plus a one-page initial-scoping template that lets PMs and Engineering make a go/no-go decision within one sprint for 80% of incoming enterprise asks. The outcome should reduce first-response SLA to 3 business days, surface risk signals earlier, and produce a standardized T-shirt size and scoping bucket for Eng.

Scope: This ticket focuses on the intake and prioritization mechanism (forms, rubric, playbook) and a 1-page scoping output. Implementation work (console changes, automation) will be tracked in follow-ups.

Non-goals: Full automation of prioritization, deep product PRD for every ask, or replacing account prioritization done by Sales leadership.
acceptance_criteria: A concise triage rubric exists and is documented in Confluence with scoring weights for: strategic fit, ACV/monetization, technical lift, compliance/regulatory, and customer urgency.
A one-page initial scoping template (user, outcome, constraints, 3 effort buckets) is created and used in 5 pilot intake cases.
Triage SLAs are defined: first-response (3 business days), PM decision window (1 sprint) and engineering spike window (2 weeks) for accepted asks.
A plan for integrating the rubric into the sales/CS intake form and a small automation spec for Slack/Email notifications is produced.
Pilot feedback is collected from Sales, CS, Eng, and Design and summarized with at least 3 concrete changes before wider rollout.
steps: Draft triage rubric with weighted criteria and example scoring (PM lead).
Create one-page initial-scoping template with explicit effort buckets: infra/runtime, model/workflow, console/UX.
Run 5 pilot intake cases across different accounts and product lines; capture time-to-decision and clarity metrics.
Gather cross-functional review (Sales, CS, Eng, Design, Legal) and iterate rubric and template.
Publish Confluence playbook and update Sales/CS intake checklist; schedule training session.
